descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**We want you to feel as good as riding in real life!**

As real-life snowboarders, we believe carving the snow in VR should be the best feeling in the world, so we tuned the physics until it felt perfect. 

**Snowboard**, **Ski** or **Snow Skate** with friends having full control of your board! Carve, jump, and grind rails. Explore 50+ official maps plus 1200+ community-created maps!
[media]

Ride on steep slopes, bowls, ramps, loops, narrow and large trails, ice caves, and many more totally crazy tracks. You can even create your own maps using Gravity Sketch.
[media]
All players are competing for time and best tricks on each map. 
You don't want to be left out of this mountain party! Bring your friends and join us in multiplayer today!

FEATURES:
- **Full control** using your hands as feet
- **Grab tricks** included!
- **Realistic Snowboard, Ski and Snow Skate physics**
- **New Gears** being added constantly.
- Explore **50**+ **official maps plus 1200**+ **community created maps**
- Change your character and your **board skin**.
- **Multiplayer** fun!
- **Race** against other players best time. 
- **Footage mode** to capture your best runs from any angle.
- **Change the time of day** and world biome.
- Optional virtual goggles to **eliminate motion sickness**.
- Find **secret areas**.

[media]
**Slowp** is still in development! There are still many features and polishing that we want to add to the whole experience. Judge it with that in mind and please give us feedback!
